objectives.label: Go down into a realm under the world

title: The lands under the land
A realm below
summary: {giver} believes there are whole lands beneath the stone, lit by their own light. Follow the cave mouths down until you stand in one, and bring back a stone from it.
offer: Miners talk of caves that open into lands, sky of stone, lakes, forests of mushrooms. Go down, find one of these realms, and bring me a stone from it.
progress: Have you seen them, the lands below?
complete: Warm, and it glows... So the stories are true.
